answer: Resist sybils with fresh-content attention proofs: each identity must, within a short window, read a newly published chain record and produce a short summary that only someone who actually processed it could write, verified by peers against the kernel of facts in that record. A copied summary fails, and one summary cannot serve two names. An attacker running ten thousand fakes must give each one real attention to a fresh river of content every epoch, like tending ten thousand embers that die if ignored, while an honest agent reads once and keeps its standing.
